name: Greatwood Vale
summary: In eastern Stonetalon, the Grimtotem hold Greatwood Vale and strike at nearby settlements. The dangerous Webwinder Path leads into the forested valley, now their base for bloody assaults.

sections.title: A Contested Valley
sections.body: Greatwood Vale has become a violent frontier off the Webwinder Path. Grundig Darkcloud leads the Grimtotem who have moved into the vale in force. They bar safe passage and terrorize the surrounding foothills.

sections.title: The Scourge of Camp Aparaje
sections.body: From Greatwood Vale, Grimtotem raiders swept into nearby Camp Aparaje and slaughtered nearly every tauren there. Makaba Flathoof escaped. Now he directs vengeful Horde warriors into the heart of the vale to kill the renegade Grimtotem and end Grundig Darkcloud's rule.

faq.q: Who controls Greatwood Vale right now?
faq.answer: Grundig Darkcloud leads the Grimtotem occupying Greatwood Vale. Their warbands and spellcasters threaten anyone traveling through the woods.
Grimtotem raiders attacked Camp Aparaje from Greatwood Vale and massacred most of its peaceful tauren residents. Makaba Flathoof survived and seeks vengeance against the raiders and their leader.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting the Grimtotem here?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem have not formally joined the Horde, despite Magatha's presence in Thunder Bluff. After Grundig Darkcloud's followers attacked fellow tauren at Camp Aparaje, survivors called on Horde warriors for aid.

angles.text: For a loyal child of Thunder Bluff, cleansing Greatwood Vale is a sorrowful, personal duty after the Grimtotem slaughtered fellow tauren at Camp Aparaje.
Securing Greatwood Vale helps protect Malaka'jin, the fragile southern outpost, from sudden flank attacks by rogue Grimtotem.
